title: She Wasn't Just His Wife
description: He spent years walking all over his quiet housewife, completely blind to the fact that she was secretly funding his entire life. When he finally crosses the line, she pulls the plug and takes back everything that was hers from day one. Good luck watching this without shouting at your screen.
